svg.title: Why I love this: cryptography because I love solving puzzles and recognizing patterns; blockchain because it's a hard, important problem and decentralization creates trust; security because it fuses decentralization, cryptography and networks; networks because they're the foundation of the internet; build and lead because I'm a natural team leader (90% of university projects led to full marks).

g.text: bassam@uqu:~$ cat why_i_love_this.md
[01] WHY CRYPTOGRAPHY?
I'm genuinely passionate about encryption because I love solving puzzles. Every time I
crack one, I feel my brain getting faster at recognizing patterns, and cryptography is
the ultimate puzzle.
[02] WHY BLOCKCHAIN?
Because it's a hard problem that really matters to people. Its decentralization gives it
a strange, almost paradoxical kind of trust: no central authority, yet records you can
rely on as immutable truth.
[03] WHY SECURITY?
Security is where everything meets. It fuses decentralization, cryptography, and
networks, and almost every technology depends on it. To me, security is the hybrid of all
technologies working together.
[04] WHY NETWORKS?
Networks are the foundation of everything, the backbone of the internet itself. If you
understand how packets move, you understand how the modern world talks.
[05] WHY BUILD & LEAD?
I've loved being the project manager and team lead since my early university days. I
enjoy running teams in a coordinated, organized way, and I've led 90% of my university
projects to full marks. Leadership isn't a role I take, it's who I am.
bassam@uqu:~$
